integrity: The finite exclusion is a complete normalized multiset enumeration with exact character-polynomial arithmetic, supplied as C++17 source; the seven-coordinate witness is separately checked by exhaustive direct Python enumeration. No general-size certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Sharp only among 2-dimensional quinary linear codes; complete 2020 Lee-weight duality paper was inaccessible; independent mathematical priority review not performed.
title: Sharp seven-coordinate threshold for Lee-weight duality failure in quinary two-dimensional codes
